member.name: P:OmicronLab.FRAnalyzer.Engine.FRAnalyzerCommandDefinition.OmicronLab#BaseEngine#Engine#Interfaces#ICommandDefinition#SourceAttenuator
member.summary: Gets or sets the source attenuator. This is a bit-mask - see remarks for details.
member.remarks:
For the Bode 100 and the FRAnalyzer / FRANEO 800 the first 3 bit are used only: - SourceAttenuator[0] = HWConfig[9] -> S(source-0) -> SOURCE_5_DB. - SourceAttenuator[1] = HWConfig[9] -> S(source-1) -> SOURCE_10_DB. - SourceAttenuator[2] = HWConfig[9] -> S(source-2) -> SOURCE_20_DB.
For the Bode 500 the first 12 bits are used. - SourceAttenuator[0-5] = attenuator 1. - SourceAttenuator[6-11] = attenuator 2.
See implementation for details.

member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the source is on.
member.remarks: When switching the source from off to on the x6 multiplier has to be switched off because this is a problem of the DDS. But there will be no crosscheck if afterwards the x6 multiplier will be set to high again, because once the source is on it will be valid to activate or deactivate the x6 multiplier. See also .

member.remarks: For frequencies equal or above 100Hz the PLL multiplier x6 will be activated. For frequencies below 100Hz the PLL multiplier x6 of the DDS will be deactivated so that the frequency is more accurate. [HWConfig[4] -> L(l-1)]. See also .

member.name: P:OmicronLab.FRAnalyzer.Engine.FRAnalyzerCommandDefinition.HardwareDelayIndex
member.summary: Gets the index of the hardware delay. If different between this index and the last index sent, a delay will be added before the actual measurement.
member.remarks: The hardware delay index is (mainly) needed when attenuator shaping will be done, because when switching the 20dB channel attenuators (CH1 and CH2) during a sweep measurement the involved HF relays need some settling time. The settling time is 0.5 milliseconds per relay which sums up to 1 milliseconds because two relays are affected.
